responsibility: Implements the analyzer’s heuristic handling of inline asm statements within region_model updates. It parses asm input/output constraints, computes regions and symbolic values reachable from asm operands, marks reachable mutable clusters as clobbered to avoid false uninitialized-value reports, and for deterministic asm creates stable asm_output_svalue results keyed by inputs so repeated calls with the same inputs can be treated consistently.
